meaning:
1) frost, ice, ice crystal
1a) frost (of night)
1b) ice

elsewhere.note: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.
Which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.
He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?
Therefore Yahweh says concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: “He will have no one to sit on David’s throne. His dead body will be cast out in the day to the heat…
Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.
